about:
Metal Masters of Florida operates from Lake City, Florida, where it was founded in 1991. The company has accumulated over three decades of experience in metals processing and fabrication, though the names of its founders are not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status have not been specified.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including CNC lathe work, precision saw cutting, CNC bending, CNC plasma cutting, CNC milling, welding and assembly, and R&D prototyping supported by an in-house CAD team. It works with stainless steel, carbon steel, aluminum, and galvanized steel, supplying custom parts and subassemblies. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Metal Masters primarily serves other manufacturers, producing components and subassemblies for the automotive, transportation, electronics, agricultural, entertainment, and kiosk industries, as well as for OEM manufacturing customers. Its job-shop model focuses on tailored solutions that fit into clients' existing production lines.

The company emphasizes volume purchasing power to keep material costs competitive, a knowledgeable sales team with decades of experience, and timely delivery to help customers maintain schedule. Rigorous quality control is applied throughout each process, and the stated goal is to minimize the total cost of acquiring and inventorying metal parts while meeting or exceeding specifications.

about:
Metal Products Co. Inc was founded in 1952 in Phoenix, Arizona, and operates from a facility in the downtown area. The company has been a continuous presence in the metal manufacturing industry since its founding.

The company specializes in custom sheet metal fabrication and the production of roofing sheets and accessories for the building trades. Its product line includes drip edge, coping and wall caps, L-metal, Z-bar, flashing, valley components, gutters, downspouts, scuppers, collector boxes, caps, pans, vents, spark arrestors, shrouds, and custom panels. All items are fabricated to order, with an emphasis on precision and durability for harsh weather conditions.

Metal Products serves primarily the roofing sector, supplying contractors, builders, and distributors involved in residential and commercial construction. Its materials are used on structures ranging from single-family homes to larger commercial buildings, where reliable water management and structural support are required.

The company states that its commitment to quality and personalized service, along with transparent pricing and a customer-centric approach, distinguish it from competitors. These principles have guided its operations since 1952.

name: MetalMania- Custom Metal Works Fabrication Shop
old_description: Handling all custom metal fabrication project with great precision and detail from beginning to end of the project.
about:
MetalMania Custom Metal Works operates from Brooklyn, New York. The shop opened in 2009, founded by a lead fabricator with over 30 years of industry experience that included 15 years reconstructing casinos in Macau, China. The business remains independently owned and has completed more than 2,500 custom projects across the five boroughs and beyond.

The company specializes in custom fabrication across six architectural metals: brass, bronze, copper, steel, 304/316 stainless steel, and zinc. Its capabilities cover welding (MIG, TIG, arc), laser and plasma cutting, bending and forming, and surface finishing such as polishing and powder coating. The shop also produces mixed-metal assemblies combining materials like brass with steel or copper with stainless steel.

MetalMania serves residential, commercial, and architectural clients. Homeowners commission custom stair railings, gates, and interior metalwork; architects and contractors specify facades, sunshades, and structural elements; businesses order branded fixtures, signage, and commercial railings. The team collaborates directly with designers and builders to integrate metalwork into broader project plans.

The firm distinguishes itself as one of the few New York City shops that fabricates in all six premium metals under one roof, leveraging the founder's Macau casino background for precision in complex geometries. It emphasizes a client-satisfaction record spanning its entire history.

name: Metalworking Group (Pippin Location)
old_description: Manufacturer of sheet metal components, weldments, UL listed electrical enclosures, and other fabrications
about:
Metalworking Group operates its Pippin Road facility in Cincinnati, Ohio, one of two plants the company runs in the city. The business traces its roots back more than 40 years, beginning with deep expertise in heavy plate and sheet metal fabrication. Today it is led by CEO Doug Watts and President Brian Dubay, who have overseen its evolution through strategic acquisitions and continuous technology investment.

The company produces sheet metal components, weldments, UL‑listed electrical enclosures, production stampings, stamping dies, fixtures, and CNC‑machined parts. Its shop floor includes 4‑axis vertical CNC machining centers, multi‑spindle lathe turning centers with live tooling, and four robotic welding cells for MIG, TIG, and robotic welding. Sheet processing capacity reaches 60 by 120 inches, and all manufacturing, finishing, assembly, kitting, packaging, warehousing, and distribution are performed in‑house.

Metalworking Group serves OEMs across the United States, Canada, and Western Europe. Its customer base spans defense and military, aerospace, medical device, fitness equipment, oil and gas, biogas reclaiming, border security, autonomous vehicle, industrial equipment, chemical dispensing, clean energy, material handling, and data‑center industries.

The firm emphasizes that ongoing investment in cutting‑edge equipment, top‑tier talent, and smarter workflows enables it to deliver precision‑built solutions and responsive support, aiming to function as an essential extension of its customers’ manufacturing teams. It holds UL Listing, ISO 9001, ITAR registration, and meets CMMC requirements for defense work.

name: Metalworks of Montana Inc.
old_description: Since 1985, Metalworks of Montana has been providing sheet metal fabrication, welding, and commercial low-slope roof contracting services throughout Montana, Idaho, and Washington.
about:
Metalworks of Montana, operating as Missoula Sheet Metal, has been based in Missoula, Montana since its founding in 1985. The company is locally owned and operated; its leadership includes President/Owner Jeff Gordon and Vice President Aiden Curran, with a team that collectively holds over 100 years of metalworking experience.

The shop provides sheet metal fabrication, welding (both in-house and on-site), and commercial low-slope roof contracting across Montana, Idaho, and Washington. It manufactures HVAC components, structural steel, architectural sheet metal, custom stainless steel products, ductwork, venting systems (including chimney caps, oven range hoods, and industrial kitchen venting), as well as custom kitchen décor, automotive accessories, signage, stairways, platforms, and mezzanines. Roofing services cover single-ply membrane, modified bitumen, and built-up systems.

Customers span commercial construction, HVAC, industrial kitchen, automotive, marine (boats, RVs, trucks, trailers), and architectural metalwork. The company holds contractor licenses in Montana (#8192), Idaho (#15815-AA-4), and Washington (#MISSOSM962MG), allowing it to serve projects throughout the Northwest.

Metalworks emphasizes customer service, listening to client needs to deliver projects exactly as specified, and draws on more than three decades of experience to offer precision fabrication and roofing solutions. It is licensed and bonded in all three states.

about:
Metropolitan Parts, Inc. operates from Hartleton, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1998 as a specialist supplier for the Nash Metropolitan.

The business maintains an inventory of over 1,000 parts covering brake, fuel, interior, electrical, engine, exterior, suspension, transmission, cooling, and exhaust systems. It runs a full restoration facility and offers a proprietary Bull Dawg line of parts manufactured to its specifications. The company also supplies original factory service manuals and provides technical support for owners and restorers.

Customers include individual Metropolitan owners, restoration shops, and collectors across the United States and internationally. The company notes free shipping for U.S. military personnel on online orders and serves a global clientele through its e-commerce site.

The founders' personal ownership of a 1956 Metropolitan drives their emphasis on fit and function; they state that hands-on experience with the vehicle allows them to verify that parts meet demanding quality standards before they are offered for sale.
